To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DO setup is more preferable in the cases with CFO compensation, and that ZF precoder outperforms MF precoder with low level of reciprociy errors.

(1) the DO setup is better than the common oscillator setup when CFO compensation is not considered, and vice versa; (2) the performance of the ZF precoder outperforms that of the MF precoder in the case of DO setup without considering the CFO compensation, or both setups with CFO compensated, whereas the opposite conclusion holds for the other cases.

the DO setup is preferred in the case of no CFO compensation, and the ZF precoder outperforms MF precoder in the case of high SNR and small reciprocity errors, whereas MF precoding is competitive with ZF precoding in the opposite cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance evaluation of large scale antenna system in the presence of RF impairments, and provides useful guidelines for system design and implementation.

the performance analysis of large scale antenna system in the presence of channel estimation error, CFO, and RF mismatch, where the impact of different precoding schemes and oscillator setups are investigated.
the performance analysis of large scale antenna system with CFO, RF quasi-static mismatch and channel estimation errors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, the performance of MF precoding in the DO setup is the most robust to CFO, quasi-static RF mismatch, and channel estimation error among all four setups.
, the ZF precoder with DO setup is preferable, whereas MF precoding with common oscillator setup is competitive in the presence of RF impairments.
, the DO oscillator setup with ZF precoding is a better option in the case without CFO compensation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CFO compensation is beneficial to the system, especially for the DO setup.
, the CFO compensation and DO setup should be adopted to improve system performance, and MF precoder is more robust to RF mismatch and channel mismatch than ZF precoder.
the DO setup with CFO compensation is preferable in massive MIMO systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the performance of the large scale antenna systems is significantly affected by the CFO, the RF mismatch, and the channel estimation error, especially when the level of reciprocity error is high.

the CFO should be compensated for in order to improve the performance of massive MIMO systems, and that the DO setup is a good choice for the cases without CFO or with CFO compensation, but the common oscillator setup is preferable in other cases.
the performance of massive multiple-input multipleoutput system is significantly degraded by the reciprocity error, and the CFO compensation is necessary in practical implementation.
